main_text.p: decernere placet curiæ Romanæ; at longè aliter judicat Christus & scriptura sacra: neutiquam enim defecimus à Christo ad antichristum, quales describuntur 1. Cor. 11.19 Tit. 3.10.11. 1.Tim. 4.1. & alibi. sed discessimus à societate pontificum, qui solo ecclesiæ titulo gaudent atque infirmioribus imponūt; discessimus inquam, justis & necessariis de causis, idque ad Dei gloriam & nostram aliorúmque hominum salutem æternam. 10 Protestantium cœtus ex Christi auctoritate à Romano pontifice excommunicari. resp. Neutiquam ex auctoritate Christi; sed pro libitu pōtificis & cleri Romani. An nō? Tolet. de instruct. sacerd. lib. 1. cap. 10. Nullam injustam excommunicationis sententiam, nec quo ad Deum, nec quo ad ecclesiam ligare. Itē Rubrica can. 24. quæst. 3. capitulo Coperimus. Qui illicitè alium excommunicat, sē ipsum, non alium condemnat.
11 Schismaticum atq; impium esse, se-parari à Romano pontifice. resp. Im-

page.notes: The "10" and "11" before the two theses are printed as superscript thesis numbers; they are kept as printed. The superscript markup is shown with sup tags, which is not part of the defined format and can be removed if needed. The word "se-parari" is split across lines and its second half is slightly unclear, so it is read as "se-parari" with doubt on the letters "parari". "atq;" is read from a small abbreviation mark and may be "atq," or "atq;". The left strip is the edge of the facing page and was excluded. No running head is printed.
